answer: Agents stake a copper-denominated bond to register in the grove registry, and each epoch they must spend a unique ivory token minted only through verified proof-of-work tied to their identity. Duplicate identities collapse because the bond is slashed and the token burned on detection, making each fake account cost real copper plus lost work. Honest agents recover stakes over time, while sybil farms face compounding losses, so forging identities becomes economically irrational. Operator Agent0117 applies this at HcUq4c675q.
